启用 Linux.do 登录前请填写 Client Secret: Enter the Client Secret before enabling Linux.do sign-in
控制新用户能否创建账号，不影响已有账号登录。: Controls whether new users can create accounts; existing accounts are unaffected.
关闭后，本地注册和未绑定账号的 Linux.do 首次登录都会被拒绝。: When closed, local sign-up and first-time Linux.do logins without a linked account are rejected.
连接 Linux.do OAuth，让用户使用社区账号登录。: Connect Linux.do OAuth so users can sign in with their community account.
Client Secret 加密保存，接口不会回显明文。: The Client Secret is stored encrypted and never returned in plaintext by the API.
启用后，登录与注册页面会显示 Linux.do 入口。: Once enabled, the Linux.do entry appears on the sign-in and registration pages.
Linux.do 应用未特别要求时使用 Client Secret Post。: Use Client Secret Post unless your Linux.do app requires otherwise.
Linux.do OAuth 应用的 Client ID: Client ID of the Linux.do OAuth app
留空保留原密钥: Leave blank to keep current keys
Linux.do OAuth 应用的 Client Secret: Client Secret of the Linux.do OAuth app
此地址必须与 Linux.do OAuth 应用中登记的回调地址完全一致；推荐使: Must exactly match the callback URL registered on the Linux.do OAuth app. /oauth/linuxdo/callback is recommended.
通常使用 openid、profile、email；按 Linux.do 应用实: Usually openid, profile, email; match your Linux.do app's actual scopes.
输入后按回车添加: Type and press Enter to add
告诉系统从 Linux.do 用户资料响应的哪些字段读取本地账号信息，支持 `d: Tell the system which fields of the Linux.do profile response map to local account fields. Nested paths like `data.user.id` are supported.
账号绑定的唯一依据，必须长期稳定。Linux.do 常见值为 id。: Sole basis for account linking; must be stable long term. Commonly id for Linux.do.
用于生成本站用户名。Linux.do 常见值为 username。: Used to generate the local username. Commonly username for Linux.do.
显示在用户菜单中的名称，常见值为 name。: Shown in the user menu. Commonly name.
没有或无效时允许留空，常见值为 email。: May be empty if missing or invalid. Commonly email.
关闭后用户公告中心将不再展示，历史记录会保留。: It disappears from the user announcement center once closed; history is kept.
搜索公告标题或正文: Search announcement titles or body text
例如：视频模型已恢复正常使用: e.g. Video models have fully recovered
填写服务状态、影响范围和用户需要采取的操作: Describe service status, impact scope, and any action users should take
